notes.title: The devs showcase the new Bobls demo and a secret extremely difficult level!
notes.notes:
Bobls is a part of an awesome, not-yet announced Steam event, come watch us play the game, have a chat with us and check out the event we're a part of!

We'll be showcasing the brand new single-player and co-op demo as well as a secret, extremely difficult level. We look forward to sharing it with you and answering your questions about the game!

[b]Live-stream starts at 3 PM PST[/b]

notes.title: Bobls is on Save & Sound - The Celebration of Music in Games
notes.notes:
Join us September 11 - 14 right here on Steam for one of the largest digital expos about audio and music in games. Save & Sound features concerts, deep-dives, and mashups from 70+ developers from around the world!

Starting at 10am PDT / 7pm CEST, a 3-day live show from September 11 - 13 will showcase original content made just for Save & Sound.
